# ProofTamil — Tamil AI Proofreading & OCR Platform

## What is ProofTamil?

ProofTamil (prooftamil.com) is an AI-powered Tamil language writing platform that provides:
- **Tamil proofreading**: Detects and corrects Tamil grammar errors, spelling mistakes, verb conjugation issues, sandhi violations, punctuation errors, and register mismatches (formal vs. spoken Tamil) in under 2 seconds.
- **Tamil Handwriting OCR**: Converts photographs of handwritten Tamil notes, printed Tamil documents, whiteboards, and scanned pages into clean, editable Tamil text.
- **AI Tamil Content Writer**: Generates Tamil and English blog posts, essays, and articles with customisable tone, length, and style.
- **Tanglish to Tamil conversion**: Converts phonetically typed English (e.g. "vanakkam nanbaa") into Tamil script (வணக்கம் நண்பா) in real time.

## Who is it for?

- Tamil students digitising handwritten class notes and proofreading essays
- Tamil bloggers, journalists, and content creators publishing error-free articles
- Businesses producing professional Tamil communications, contracts, and marketing copy
- Tamil diaspora communities worldwide (India, Singapore, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, Canada, USA, UK, Australia)
- Tamil language teachers and schools

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2024
- Headquarters: Tamil Nadu, India
- Website: https://prooftamil.com
- Languages supported: Tamil (தமிழ்), English
- Platform: Web-based, no download required
- Free tier: Proofreading up to 200 words per check, 30 AI checks/day, 2 OCR conversions/day
- Premium: Unlimited proofreading, unlimited OCR, priority processing
